project.name: Cristian Clock Synchronization HANDMADE
project.description: Cristian's algorithm: a client asks the time server (node-1) for its time Ts, measures the round-trip time RTT on its own clock, and sets its clock to Ts + RTT/2. Every node has a simulated clock with its own initial offset and exaggerated drift; errorMs shows how far it is from real time.
